description.content: Revert is an open-source unified API platform that makes it easy to build integrations with third-party services including CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Pipedrive, Close CRM), ticketing systems (Jira, Asana), accounting (Xero, QuickBooks), chat (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord), and more — all through a single standardized API.
